models.mechanism: The incursion reading is now directly anchored by the dawn-raid branch. The focus runners no longer merely might cross a boundary; in the revealed sequence they become the first audible phase of an approach that strikes, then arrives as a morning raid or alarm. Panting is thus the breath of an oncoming force before its social effect becomes visible.

structural_cues: The three ayat are linked by successive فـ clauses, producing an approach-strike-raid sequence.
The repeated plural participles العاديات / الموريات / المغيرات preserve a collective agent across the phases.
100:3 adds صُبْحًا as a time noun, but its branch inventory also contains the morning raid and alarm cry, converting neutral arrival into social shock.
The stage-1 approach-then-contact model gains a named dawn incursion rather than only inferred hostile crossing.

abductive_moves.assumption: The dawn raid in 100:3 identifies the social purpose of the panting and striking in 100:1-2.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies sequential forms and the morning-raid branch, but it does not explicitly state that the panting in 100:1 is caused by raiding intention.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: panting runners, spark-producing strike, dawn raid/alarm; inferred arrow: the running and striking are preparatory phases that culminate in a dawn incursion.
alternatives: 100:3 could add a third oath image without retroactively specifying the first two.
The dawn cue may be temporal only, with no hostile social frame.

changed_reading.before: At stage 1, the focus leaned toward an advance that reaches contact, but the target and event type remained unstated.
changed_reading.after: After 100:3, the focus reads as the audible first stage of a dawn incursion: panting approach, striking contact, then raid and alarm.

models.ablation: Removing 100:3 ص ب ح/B004 collapses the model back to the stage-1 speculative incursion with contact but no named raid-time or alarm. Removing ع د و/B001 leaves a dawn movement scene without the focus-root bridge to boundary-crossing aggression.

models.mechanism: The material ignition model is revised by dawn: sparks are no longer only a trace of friction but a transition from concealed nocturnal force into visible morning. The focus panting becomes the dark, pre-visual pressure of motion; 100:2 externalizes it as sparks; 100:3 opens the scene into dawn light and changed state.

structural_cues: 100:1-3 progress from sound ضبحا to spark قدحا to dawn صبحا.
The newly revealed ص ب ح root contributes both dawn and lamp/light branches, matching the prior fire emergence in 100:2.
غ ي ر/B003 gives a formal change-of-state cue that fits the sequence from hidden fire to visible morning.
The focus-root fire branch ض ب ح/B003 remains the bridge that lets later light imagery alter the reading of 100:1.

abductive_moves.assumption: The sequence from panting to sparks to dawn should be read as an unveiling of energy and visibility rather than only three separate sensory details.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies sound, striking fire, and dawn/light branches, but not the abstract transformation model.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: breath-sound, hidden fire struck out, dawn/light and change-of-state; inferred arrow: intense motion generates visible sparks and participates in the scene's transition into morning visibility.
alternatives: Dawn may function only as the time of the charge, not as a light-source continuation of sparks.
The spark may remain local hoof-fire without changing the reading of the focus breath.

changed_reading.before: At stage 1, the focus panting was the pre-impact phase of ignition against resistant matter.
changed_reading.after: After 100:3, the focus panting is also the dark or pre-visible phase of a transformation into sparks and dawn light.

models.ablation: Removing 100:3 ص ب ح/B001 and B005 leaves the strong stage-1 ignition model but collapses the new dawn/visibility revision. Removing ض ب ح/B003 breaks the focus-root connection to fire, making 100:1 only auditory while the later light sequence stands apart.

models.mechanism: The exertion model is revised into a timed mobilization. Panting is not merely bodily cost or stored energy; with 100:3 it becomes the exertion required to arrive at a precise morning threshold. The force expended in 100:1 is organized toward a timed emergence: breath, spark, dawn arrival.

structural_cues: The third manner/time noun صُبْحًا parallels ضبحا and قدحا, but shifts the sequence from bodily and material mode to temporal arrival.
The فـ chain makes the exertion cumulative: running, then striking sparks, then arriving at dawn.
ص ب ح/B002 supplies morning arrival, which revises generic speed into scheduled or threshold-directed speed.

abductive_moves.assumption: Panting indicates the cost of synchronizing motion with a dawn endpoint.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet gives running and morning arrival, but does not state that the runners strain because timing matters.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: running with breath, striking sparks, coming at morning; inferred arrow: the need to reach the morning threshold organizes and intensifies the exertion.
alternatives: The dawn phrase may simply locate the scene in time without implying timed effort.
The panting may remain a generic animal detail unaffected by the morning cue.

changed_reading.before: At stage 1, the focus read as charged motion whose force would be released outward as sparks.
changed_reading.after: After 100:3, the focus also reads as timed strain: the runners pant because their motion is driving toward a morning arrival.

models.ablation: Removing 100:3 ص ب ح/B002 and B009 leaves the stage-1 energy-conversion reading but removes the new timed-arrival revision. Removing ض ب ح/B001 leaves haste toward dawn without the focus-specific bodily cost.

surprise_reading: With 100:3 added, the panting racers become the first audible stage of a dawn event. One activated reading now strongly sees them as the approach of a boundary-crossing raid that strikes and alarms at morning. A second keeps the fire mechanism but revises it into a transition from hidden pressure to sparks and dawn light. A third treats the panting as timed exertion: speed spent to reach the morning threshold.
